title: Matrix Deposition using the SunChrom Sprayer
author: Manuel Liebeke
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ug5ety6
materials: Leave the computer and instrument switched on.

steps.title: Initialize Nitrogen Flow
steps.instruction: Open the Nitrogen Flow to 2 bar.

steps.title: Clean the Syringe Pump
steps.instruction: Flush the syringe pump with cleaning solution.

substeps.instruction: Remove the 1 ml syringe from the pump, fill it with cleaning solution, and remount it.
Set the flow rate to 20 µl/min and start the flow.
Verify that droplets are emerging from the end of the spraying capillary.
Stop the flow once at least 600 µl have passed (approximately 30 min), ensuring the pump does not run to the very end to avoid motor damage.

steps.title: Prepare Test Slide and Matrix
steps.instruction: Prepare the matrix and a test slide for deposition.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the appropriate matrix.
Weigh a test slide of the same type as the tissue section slide (Superfrost, Poly-L-Lysine).

steps.title: Configure Spraying Program
steps.instruction: Set up the spraying parameters and slide positioning in the software.

substeps.instruction: Insert the test slide into the SunCollect Sprayer slide holder.
Open the Tissue Setup in the spraying program and load the appropriate method.
Navigate to Positioning in the method file to define the spray area.
Move the spraying capillary to the top left corner (x1, y1) and press Insert coordinates.
Move the spraying capillary to the bottom right corner (x2, y2) and press Insert coordinates.
Press the Teaching button and click OK to return the capillary to the home position.
Verify that the Z-position in the method file matches the method name; update it if necessary.

steps.title: Perform Test Matrix Deposition
steps.instruction: Apply matrix to the test slide to verify reproducibility.

substeps.instruction: Remove the 1 ml syringe, fill it with matrix, and remount it to the pump.
Start the dispenser and verify that droplets are coming out of the spraying capillary.
Press the play button to start the method (applying flow rate and number of layers as set).
Wait for the method to finish; the flow will stop and the capillary will return home.
Weigh the sprayed slide and calculate the amount of deposited matrix to check for reproducibility.

steps.title: Perform Sample Matrix Deposition
steps.instruction: Apply matrix to the actual tissue section slide.

substeps.instruction: Insert the slide containing the tissue section into the same position as the test slide.
Determine if the syringe needs refilling with matrix (and initialize dispenser in the method) or if the remaining matrix is sufficient for all layers.
Start the dispenser and verify that droplets are coming out of the spraying capillary.
Press the play button to start the same method used for the test slide.
Once finished, remove the sample slide and store it safely in a slidebox.

steps.title: System Shutdown and Final Cleaning
steps.instruction: Clean the system and close the software.

substeps.instruction: Remove the 1 ml syringe and discard remaining matrix (unless another sample is being sprayed).
Fill the syringe with cleaning solution and remount it to the pump.
Perform the cleaning process as described in the initial cleaning step (Step 2).
After stopping the syringe pump, leave the remaining cleaning solvent in the syringe for 2 minutes while the Nitrogen flow dries the capillary to prevent matrix crystallization.
Close the Tissue Setup and the SunCollect program.
